transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this meeting to review a late-withdrawal petition for BIO 210. As you all know, the standard withdrawal deadline of October 18, 2025 has passed, and the student is still listed as enrolled. Before I make a final decision, I need to go through our standard review process — checking in with the course instructor, academic counseling, financial aid, and disability services. I'd like to hear from each of you regarding this student's situation so I can determine whether a qualifying exception applies.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Dr. Morgan. Thank you for including me in this review. As the BIO 210 instructor, I do have relevant information regarding this student's academic engagement in the course. My attendance and assignment records indicate that the student's last date of academic engagement was October 14, 2025. I have this documented in my course notes. I believe this date may be relevant to your review of the late-withdrawal petition, particularly in establishing the timeline of the student's participation in the course.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've reviewed the student's hospital discharge documentation, which confirms a medical inability to participate from October 15 through the end of the term. This documentation qualifies the petition for the college's retroactive medical-withdrawal exception. However, I should note that the documentation has not yet been attached to the petition packet, so we'll need to ensure it's included before the final decision is made.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I should note for the record that I've confirmed processing this petition as a medical withdrawal will produce a 50 percent tuition credit, since the withdrawal falls within the college's documented medical-adjustment window. I've recorded this in the aid office file, but I have not yet entered it in the student account system.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share an important item from my disability services records. My accommodation log shows that this student had an active extended-time accommodation on October 14, 2025, but the BIO 210 midterm was administered without it. Disability services requires the registrar to remove the resulting exam penalty through a grade-record correction when the withdrawal is processed. I want to flag that this correction request has not yet been filed, and it will need to be addressed as part of finalizing this petition.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Attach the student's hospital discharge documentation to the petition packet before finalizing the decision.
Enter the 50 percent tuition credit in the student account system as part of processing the medical withdrawal.
File the grade-record correction request to remove the midterm exam penalty resulting from the unadministered extended-time accommodation on October 14, 2025.
